usedFor: Reckon One holds invoices, payments and contacts, and “New Invoice” there can feed values to the “Memory” action in Memory.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice” in Reckon One, then “Memory” in Memory
bestTemplate.why: It saves invoice data as a key-value pair that you can read back later with findFromMemory.

watchOut: “Delete Records” in Memory removes records from Workspace Memory, so connect it to “New Payment” only on purpose.
